title: Final Force Expression (a)
description: Essential Criteria - The correct expression for the force on an electron derived from the electric field in part (a) must be provided.

title: Final Force Expression (b)
description: Essential Criteria - The correct expression for the force on an electron in the laboratory frame in part (b) must be provided.

title: Final Force Expression (c)
description: Essential Criteria - The correct expression for the force on an electron as seen by an observer moving with the beam in part (c) must be provided.

title: Magnetic Field Gradient (d)
description: Essential Criteria - The correct gradient of the magnetic field required to hold the beam from spreading in part (d) must be provided.

title: Use of Lorentz Factor
description: Important Criteria - The correct application of the Lorentz factor in transforming charge density and electric fields must be shown.

title: Electric Field Calculation
description: Important Criteria - The derivation of the electric field inside the cylindrical column must be correctly performed using Gauss' law.

title: Comparison of Forces
description: Important Criteria - A clear comparison of the forces in different frames of reference must be articulated, highlighting the effects of the magnetic field.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria - Common errors related to the signs of forces or electric fields must be avoided.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria - Ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations to avoid mistakes.
